events.title: The Football League confirms that no team will be relegated to the GM Vauxhall Conference this year, as none of the teams in the top half of the Conference (which, curiously, includes former League members 사우스포트 ) have a ground which meets the criteria for admission to the League. The recent requirement that all clubs must have a stadium holding at least 6,000 fans (1,200 or more seated) and must own their own stadium is the result of the collapse of Maidstone United at the start of last season; they had won promotion to the Football League in 1989 but had no home of their own at the time and went on to spend a large sum of money on purchasing a piece of land with the intention of building a stadium there, only to be refused planning permission to build the stadium. This leaves 노샘프턴 타운 and 달링턴 , who are both well adrift at the bottom of Division Three, fighting only the dishonour of placing as the League's bottom club. Northampton are in the process of building a new stadium to replace the County Ground later this year.

events.title: April draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the league, though leading by just two points with a game in hand over 블랙번 로버스, the only team who now stand a mathematical chance of catching them. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 아스널 and 리즈 유나이티드 complete the top five, which a resurgent 윔블던 would now be in had it not been for their weaker form earlier on in the season. 스윈던 타운, meanwhile, have had their relegation confirmed as they occupy bottom place with a mere 27 points and just four wins so far this season, although they did record a first away win in the top flight today by beating QPR 3–1 at Loftus Road. 올덤 애슬레틱 and 셰필드 유나이티드 complete the bottom three, while 사우샘프턴, 에버턴, 입스위치 타운, 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 맨체스터 시티 are still under threat of relegation. 크리스털 팰리스 and 노팅엄 포리스트 will be playing Premier League football next season after sealing promotion from Division One, a year after relegation. The playoff zone is occupied by 트랜미어 로버스, 레스터 시티, 더비 카운티 and 밀월, but there is still a chance of 노츠 카운티 or 울버햄프턴 원더러스 ousting 밀월 from the playoff places. The last game is played in front of 리버풀's Spion Kop before it is rebuilt as an all-seater stand. 노팅엄 포리스트's promotion was secured today with a 3–2 win at doomed Peterborough.

events.title: On the final weekend of the Premier League season, Oldham go in to their final game at 노리치 시티 needing a win to stand any chance of survival, but a 1–1 draw at Carrow Road is not enough to save them and they go down after three seasons in the top flight.
